display.purpose: Fraunces headlines only — section and page heads.

label.purpose: Uppercase tracked kicker paired with a gold hairline.

shadows.name: rest-lift
shadows.purpose: Resting shadow-sm on primary buttons and select raised elements.

shadows.name: hover-lift
shadows.purpose: shadow-md response on hover for interactive surfaces.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default state transition for buttons and interactive elements.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The canonical marketing CTA (e.g. 'Book a discovery call'). Pill-shaped, Stone Sage.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: #7E8A77; color: #FAF8F4; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(34,38,34,0.06); transition: all 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #6D7867; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(34,38,34,0.10); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FAF8F4, 0 0 0 4px #7E8A77; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-commitment action (e.g. 'Explore services'). Outline that inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: transparent; color: #222622; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.95rem; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(34,38,34,0.20); border-radius: 9999px; transition: all 200ms ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #222622; color: #FAF8F4; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #FAF8F4, 0 0 0 4px #7E8A77; }

components.name: Eyebrow
components.description: The brand kicker: gold hairline + uppercase tracked label. A deliberate signature, not per-section scaffolding.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.24em; color: #5E655C; } .ds-eyebrow-line { display: inline-block; height: 1px; width: 24px; background: #B49A6C; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat-at-rest content surface. Cloud fill on the Ivory page, tone-led separation.
components.html:
Executive Assistance

Discreet, senior-level support for leaders who need leverage, not oversight.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FAF8F4; color: #222622; border: 1px solid rgba(34,38,34,0.12); border-radius: 10px; padding: 24px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; line-height: 1.2; letter-spacing: -0.01em; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-body { font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.65; color: #5E655C; margin: 0; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact/inquiry field. White on the warm page, sage focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; background: #FFFFFF; color: #222622; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1.5; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(34,38,34,0.12); border-radius: 10px; transition: box-shadow 200ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #5E655C; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(126,138,119,0.5); border-color: #7E8A77; }

narrative.overview: SageStone is the calm opposite of transactional outsourcing, and the interface has to feel that way before a single word is read. The system is built on stone and sage: warm ivory light, soft neutral surfaces, deep charcoal ink, and a single muted-gold accent used like a struck line in a ledger. Fraunces carries the headlines with quiet editorial warmth; Inter does the honest, legible work of the body. Reassurance is the job, and reassurance is delivered through restraint. Depth is tonal, not dramatic — surfaces are mostly flat, layered by subtle shifts in the stone-and-ivory ramp, with shadow used only as a whisper of lift on interactive elements.
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral stone palette with one muted-gold accent, held to a whisper
Fraunces (display) + Inter (body): editorial warmth over honest legibility
Flat, tonally-layered surfaces; shadow only as a response to state
Soft-rounded, restrained components; pill-shaped primary actions
Calm density — generous whitespace, no visual crowding

rules.name: The One Gold Rule
rules.body: Muted Gold appears on ≤10% of any screen — a hairline, a mark, a single detail. It is never a fill, never a gradient, never a second voice. Its scarcity is the entire point.

rules.name: The Grounded Green Rule
rules.body: Stone Sage is greyed and calm by design. Never brighten or saturate it toward a 'fresh/eco' green; that reads as wellness startup, not bedrock.

rules.name: The Deliberate Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The uppercase tracked eyebrow with its gold hairline is a chosen brand signature — but it earns its place per section, not by reflex on every one.

rules.name: The Serif-Where-It-Counts Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is for headings and rare display moments only. Body copy is always Inter.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If a shadow is doing decorative work rather than signaling state, delete it and separate the surfaces with tone instead.

dos: Do keep Warm Ivory (#F5F1E8) as the page ground and let Cloud/Soft Stone layer depth tonally.
Do hold Muted Gold to ≤10% of any screen — hairlines and marks only.
Do set headlines in Fraunces and body in Inter; cap body measure at 65–75ch.
Do use the pill primary button in Stone Sage → Sage Deep on hover for the 'Book a discovery call' CTA.
Do keep surfaces flat at rest; use shadow only as a state response.
Do meet WCAG 2.1 AA — verify Slate Olive and Muted Gold on Ivory hit ≥4.5:1 for body text.
Do provide a prefers-reduced-motion alternative for every motion-driven animation.
Do vary section spacing and eyebrow cadence for rhythm.
donts: Don't ship the cheap, high-volume BPO look — no crowded, price-war, call-center layouts.
Don't ship generic SaaS clichés — no purple gradients, no hero-metric template, no endless identical card grids.
Don't ship stiff corporate consulting — no jargon walls, no rigid enterprise stock photography.
Don't ship loud, gimmicky startup energy — no neon, no aggressive urgency, no emoji spam.
Don't brighten or saturate Stone Sage toward a fresh/eco green.
Don't put the tracked eyebrow on every single section by reflex.
Don't use border-left/border-right > 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't use gradient text or decorative glassmorphism.
Don't set long-form body copy in Fraunces.
